title: Upgrade tonic to v0.14.6 in qdrant gRPC API layer
mini_srs: Upgrade the qdrant contract repository gRPC framework from tonic 0.11/prost-build to tonic 0.14.6/tonic-prost-build. The build system in lib/api/build.rs switches from tonic_build::configure() to tonic_prost_build::configure() with compile_protos(), adds tonic-prost runtime crate to Cargo.toml, and emits explicit cargo:rerun-if-changed directives to work around a tonic-prost-build regression (grpc-rust #2415). All protobuf bindings in qdrant.rs and grpc.health.v1.rs are regenerated with the new codegen which auto-derives Eq and Hash on message types, replaces tonic::body::BoxBody with tonic::body::Body, and switches tonic::codec::ProstCodec to tonic_prost::ProstCodec. Verified by the existing test suite compiling and passing against the regenerated bindings.
expansion_rationale: Single-commit foundation milestone. Patch proc_data/patches/9c0248c.patch confirms changes span 4 files: lib/api/Cargo.toml (+tonic-prost; -tonic-build -prost-build +tonic-prost-build), lib/api/build.rs (tonic_prost_build migration, compile_protos, rerun-if-changed workaround citing grpc-rust#2415/#2511), grpc.health.v1.rs and qdrant.rs (bulk codegen regeneration). All 65 DAG descendants verified as downstream feature work — patches for b66eea6 (macOS linker fix), 3885c01 (gRPC response time), 6f50938 (TextQuery numbering), ef0dc1a (pre-encoded body) confirm none relate to the framework upgrade itself. Cross-group context confirms descendants belong to G02 (v1.19 features), G03 (filter/search), G04 (BM25), G05 (quota), G06 (filter extensions).

title: Upgrade tonic/prost/reqwest dependencies in rust-client SDK
mini_srs: Upgrade the rust-client SDK core dependencies to tonic 0.14.6 with tonic-prost runtime, prost 0.14.3, reqwest 0.13.4, and thiserror 2.0. The tonic-prost-build codegen now auto-derives Eq and Hash for message types where possible, making the manual Hash implementation for PointId in grpc_conversions/extensions.rs redundant — it is removed in favor of the derive. The reqwest upgrade renames the rustls-tls feature to rustls. The generated src/qdrant.rs is fully regenerated with the new toolchain, producing the same tonic::body::Body and tonic_prost::ProstCodec patterns as the qdrant contract repo. Verified by the existing client test suite passing against the regenerated bindings.
expansion_rationale: Single-commit foundation milestone. Patch proc_data/patches/4c4e356.patch confirms changes span 2 files: src/grpc_conversions/extensions.rs (removes 11-line manual Hash impl for PointId, lines 296-306) and src/qdrant.rs (bulk regeneration: BoxBody->Body, ProstCodec migration, Eq+Hash derives added to ~80 message types). PR #283 commit message details each dependency bump (anyhow, futures, semver, serde, tokio, uuid, prost 0.14.3, tonic 0.14.6, reqwest 0.13.4, thiserror 2.0.18) and explains tonic-prost extraction and PointId Hash conflict. All 8 DAG descendants are downstream proto syncs or features — 3631300 (G02 v1.19 sync), 8c14f9f (G07 serverless), 5ffa732 (G03 proto sync), 0dca5bf (G04 dev sync).
